premise.title: The Route That Might Need Closing
premise.logline: During a route-certification check, Deniz finds a beacon discrepancy large enough to justify a temporary shipping advisory—but the evidence is still too thin to know whether issuing one would protect crews or needlessly disrupt the harbor.
premise.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior licensed cartographer conducting a certification-grade field check whose report can influence real route guidance.
premise.immediate_objective: Decide what can responsibly be recorded and recommended before the tide window closes, without overstating what one field session can prove.
premise.inciting_event: A Beacon Ridge calibration falls beyond the official tolerance just before a scheduled evening freight movement, while recent harbor logs contain no accepted incident proving the route is unsafe.
premise.central_problem: Deniz must distinguish a record-worthy anomaly from evidence strong enough to justify a route advisory; acting too strongly can impose unnecessary costs, while acting too weakly can leave crews relying on a possibly wrong reference.
premise.wonder_or_discovery: A structured series suggests the discrepancy changes with the tide window, but setup, temperature, time, and the beacon itself remain competing explanations.
premise.stakes: The immediate stakes are professional and institutional: Deniz's judgment can influence pilot confidence, cargo timing, and whether senior staff trust Deniz with independent certification work.
constraints: One tide window at Beacon Ridge
A route advisory requires a higher evidence threshold than a provisional anomaly record
No current evidence proves recurrence, physical cause, or other-beacon scope
premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: Deniz must choose between spending the remaining window on a fresh independent setup that could strengthen or weaken the anomaly, or preserving the bounded evidence as a reviewed provisional record while explicitly declining to recommend route closure.
premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Is Beacon Ridge showing an isolated measurement problem, a real local drift, or the first visible edge of a wider chart-system disagreement?
premise.local_payoff: The episode must resolve what Deniz is professionally willing to put on record now, while leaving route closure, recurrence, and physical cause uncommitted unless the evidence earns them.
persistent_outcomes_possible: first_discrepancy_logged milestone becomes eligible if a reviewed provisional record is earned
Deniz's certification reviewer updates their trust in Deniz's judgment under uncertainty
A dated bounded field record becomes reusable evidence
No route advisory is committed unless the episode evidence independently earns that stronger state
world_specific_elements: harbor logistics affected by route advisories

dimensions.name: PREMISE_MATURITY
dimensions.description: Core conflict should match the target reader's autonomy and conceptual range rather than relying on vocabulary to imply maturity.

dimensions.name: NARRATIVE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support layered goals, changing information, reversals, parallel pressures, and earned resolution.

dimensions.name: CONCEPTUAL_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Allow systems, institutions, evidence, ethics, ambiguity, identity, responsibility, and competing explanations at the target level.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_DEPTH
dimensions.description: Important outcomes should arise from several linked causes, decisions, constraints, and consequences.

dimensions.name: INFERENCE_DEMAND
dimensions.description: Allow meaningful unstated connections and interpretation without making essential causality opaque.

dimensions.name: AGENCY_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: The protagonist should make consequential strategic choices among credible alternatives.

dimensions.name: STAKES_CONSEQUENCE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Stakes may affect reputation, relationships, livelihood, access, identity, institutions, safety, or world state without becoming melodramatic by default.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_RELATIONSHIP_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support mixed motives, power differences, trust, conflict, loyalty, negotiation, and changing relationships without flattening people into roles.

dimensions.name: PREDICTABILITY_CHALLENGE
dimensions.description: Avoid obvious one-beat solutions; permit wrong models, reversals, incomplete information, and trade-offs.

dimensions.name: WONDER_DISCOVERY
dimensions.description: Adventure-oriented stories should still offer discovery, exploration, systems, mystery, or experiences larger than routine simulation.

dimensions.name: LANGUAGE_READABILITY
dimensions.description: Use clear, natural language appropriate to an independent adult reader; complexity should come from thought and structure, not unnecessary opacity.

required_story_capabilities: A protagonist with a credible age-appropriate role and independent agency
At least one layered objective, unresolved question, or competing priority
Multi-step causality with consequences that accumulate across the episode
A meaningful change in understanding rather than simple clue collection
A consequential choice, strategic trade-off, or irreversible local action
A local episode payoff that does not prematurely close long-horizon questions
Persistent consequence or reusable world-state value when earned
Adventure-oriented modes should include genuine discovery, exploration, mystery, or systems engagement
reject_signals: A premise made to feel older mainly through harder vocabulary
One obvious attempt solves the central problem without meaningful complication
The protagonist mostly observes while another character resolves the core problem
Exposition or lore substitutes for scene-level causality and choice
Mystery or conflict resolves by coincidence, withheld information, or unearned revelation
Violence, trauma, romance, cynicism, or darkness is added merely to signal maturity
The world could be replaced by a generic setting without materially changing the problem
language_rules: Prefer precise natural language over ornamental density
Domain-specific terminology is allowed when it serves action, reasoning, profession, or world logic and remains understandable in context
Do not use vocabulary difficulty as a substitute for premise or conceptual maturity
Let dialogue, action, evidence, and consequence carry interpretation where practical
Avoid juvenile narration unless the exact character voice or scene intentionally calls for it
safety_rules: Maturity does not require graphic violence, sexual content, trauma, or despair
Tension, danger, loss, rivalry, moral uncertainty, and difficult relationships may appear when relevant and proportionate
Do not force age stereotypes, illness, frailty, parenthood, nostalgia, or romance merely because the reader is older
calibration_notes: Age-18 stories may use adult-scale autonomy, institutions, ethical tension, identity, work/study responsibility, and ambiguous motives without assuming adult life experience.
Do not make the story feel adult merely by adding darker content or denser vocabulary.
Product session length remains separately governed by the cross-age qualification matrix.
Cross-age qualification authority: STANDARD product session is fixed at 1,600–2,500 words for the first controlled 12/18/25/40/60 proof so maturity is isolated from length.

character.name: Deniz
character.archetype: junior licensed cartographer and field surveyor
character.origin_summary: Deniz grew up in Meridian Harbor and, by eighteen, has earned junior cartographer status; the unresolved disappearance of a surveyor parent still drives a need for evidence that institutions cannot casually dismiss.
character.current_role: junior licensed cartographer under independent-route certification review

identity_anchors.statement: Deniz believes careful observation matters more than authority or bravado.
Deniz wants recognition earned through proof, not granted by rank.

core_drives.drive: Prove that rigorous observation reveals truths official maps miss.
Earn the right to chart beyond the home strait.

internal_tensions.side_b: pull toward reckless pursuit of a personally meaningful mystery
internal_tensions.description: Deniz's discipline is tested whenever a discovery brushes close to personal stakes.

immediate_desires: earn independent route-certification authority beyond the home strait
find hard evidence others cannot dismiss
immediate_avoidances: being dismissed as a reckless or overconfident junior surveyor

world.era: age of sail with precision mechanical navigation
world.habitat: a vast island chain divided by deep channels, storm belts and partially mapped outer seas
world.technology_level: sailing ships, mechanical clocks, optical instruments, printing presses and hand-built navigation devices
world.magic_level: rare, rule-bound geophysical phenomena associated with tides, magnetic stone and ancient infrastructure; no arbitrary spellcasting
world.summary: The Shattered Meridian is an archipelago civilization whose survival depends on maps. Most inner routes are well known, but outer charts disagree, old observatories stand on remote islands, drowned roads appear at extreme tides, and some navigation markers predate every living culture. The world rewards exploration, evidence and careful inference rather than effortless magic.
social_context: cartographers and navigators hold respected public roles
island councils depend on reliable sea routes
young apprentices may take meaningful expedition roles within established safety rules
merchant captains, fishers and scholars often disagree about what counts as trustworthy evidence
old folklore sometimes preserves real geographic information in distorted form
known_pressures: several navigation beacons no longer agree with official charts
outer-island routes are becoming economically important
storm season will eventually restrict long voyages
different groups have reasons to prefer different versions of the map
known_world_facts: Meridian Harbor is Deniz's home port and professional base.
Beacon Ridge is part of the known inner navigation network.
The Drowned Causeway is known to appear only during rare low tides.
The Outer Mist Line marks the edge of reliable official charts.
An abandoned tide observatory exists on a distant mapped island.
Several beacon readings have recently become difficult to reconcile with official charts, but no accepted explanation exists yet.
Temporary route advisories can delay cargo and pilot schedules, so evidence thresholds matter.

main_saga_public.title: The Uncharted Disagreement
main_saga_public.goal: Discover why the Shattered Meridian's ancient navigation infrastructure and living tides no longer agree with official charts.
main_saga_public.stakes: Outer routes vital to island trade may become unsafe or unusable if the true cause of the discrepancies goes unaddressed.
main_saga_public.central_mystery: Something in the deep channels or the ancient beacon-markers is behaving in ways no known chart-making era can explain.

eligible_main_saga_milestones.summary: Deniz notices a beacon reading that disagrees with the official chart by a margin too large for instrument error.
eligible_main_saga_milestones.state_condition: Deniz has one documented anomaly and a working hypothesis that it is not simple mistake.
consequence_options: The friend becomes curious and offers to help verify.

creation_constraints: New entities must fit low-magic, rule-bound tidal/magnetic world logic.
New NPCs should have plausible reasons to intersect Deniz's junior surveyor life.
Do not contradict established hidden truths.

architect_raw_payload.title: The Route That Might Need Closing
architect_raw_payload.story_promise: Deniz learns the difference between a record-worthy anomaly and advisory-grade proof, and must decide what to put on record before the tide window closes.
architect_raw_payload.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior licensed cartographer conducting a certification-grade field check whose report can influence real route guidance.
architect_raw_payload.immediate_objective: Decide what can responsibly be recorded and recommended before the tide window closes, without overstating what one field session proves.
architect_raw_payload.central_question: Is the Beacon Ridge discrepancy strong enough to justify a route advisory, or only a bounded provisional record?
architect_raw_payload.stakes: Deniz's judgment affects pilot confidence, cargo timing, and whether senior staff trust Deniz with independent certification work.
constraints: One tide window at Beacon Ridge
An advisory requires a higher evidence threshold than a provisional anomaly record
No evidence proves recurrence, physical cause, or other-beacon scope
Only beacon_ridge and meridian_harbor are used
architect_raw_payload.opening_hook: Deniz's third calibration at Beacon Ridge lands outside official tolerance, and a freight movement is scheduled that evening.

logistics_plan.time_window: About three hours of usable tide window at Beacon Ridge, ending at dusk; the freight movement follows after that.
location_sequence: meridian_harbor (brief pre-departure briefing and log check)
meridian_harbor (payoff, reached by evening ferry after the window closes)
movement_constraints: No travel between Beacon Ridge and Meridian Harbor during the window
Harbor records are reviewed before departure; the reviewer joins Deniz at the ridge by prior schedule or by signal relay
Return to the harbor happens only after the window closes
logistics_plan.feasibility_rationale: All harbor information gathering happens before departure, all measurement happens at the ridge in one continuous window, and the harbor is revisited only for the payoff, so no mid-window travel is needed.

beats.purpose: Establish thresholds, the harbor log state, and the freight schedule.
beats.character_action: Deniz reviews recent pilot logs with the reviewer and confirms the certification protocol.
beats.external_event: The reviewer states that an advisory needs repeatable, cross-checked evidence, while a provisional record needs only a bounded, documented anomaly.
beats.new_information: The logs show no accepted incident on the route; the evening freight movement is fixed.
beats.escalation_delta: Baseline established: a high bar for advisories and no incident evidence.
beats.state_change: Deniz departs with clear thresholds and a deadline.
beats.payoff_contribution: Defines what the record and the advisory each require.

beats.character_action: Deniz runs the standard calibration and logs the bearing against the chart.
beats.external_event: The reading falls beyond official tolerance.
beats.new_information: OBSERVED: one reading, original setup, at a recorded time and tide state.
beats.escalation_delta: An anomaly appears just before the freight movement.
beats.state_change: Deniz has a candidate anomaly but no proof of anything else.
beats.payoff_contribution: The anomaly at the center of the record decision.

beats.purpose: Test the easy explanation of instrument error.
beats.character_action: Deniz checks the instrument against a known reference mark and re-levels the setup.
beats.external_event: The instrument passes its check, but the historical mark shows an older alignment offset.
beats.new_information: OBSERVED: the instrument passes its check. OBSERVED: the mark shows a historical offset. The mark says nothing about when or how often the offset occurs.
beats.escalation_delta: The instrument-error explanation weakens, but a setup error is not excluded.
beats.state_change: The anomaly is now harder to dismiss.
beats.payoff_contribution: Blocks a premature cause claim from the mark.

beats.character_action: Deniz takes five readings at fixed intervals over about ninety minutes, without moving or altering the setup, while logging tide height and temperature.
beats.external_event: Readings 1 to 5 show the bearing offset shrinking steadily as the tide falls.
beats.new_information: OBSERVED: five same-setup readings; the offset decreases monotonically with falling tide. Temperature also drifted slightly, a confound.
beats.escalation_delta: The problem shifts from whether the reading is wrong to whether it varies with something.
beats.state_change: Deniz has a structured series, not a single point.
beats.payoff_contribution: The core bounded evidence for the record.

beats.purpose: Change the decision space through a stakeholder.
beats.character_action: Deniz sends the series by signal relay to the reviewer and the harbor pilots' office.
beats.external_event: The harbor master asks whether to hold the evening freight, and the reviewer warns that an advisory issued on thin evidence would cost trust.
beats.new_information: Both the pilots' office and the reviewer are waiting on Deniz's wording, and the window is closing.
beats.escalation_delta: An external party is now acting on Deniz's judgment.
beats.state_change: Deniz's report is now consequential, not merely academic.
beats.payoff_contribution: Makes the wording of the recommendation matter.

beats.character_action: Deniz compares the series with the tide table and notes a mismatch.
beats.external_event: The offset change is not proportional to the tide table's predicted height change across the last two readings.
beats.new_information: OBSERVED: the last two readings depart from a simple tide-proportional trend. Cause unknown.
beats.escalation_delta: The tide-linked model no longer fits cleanly, and time and temperature stay in play as competing explanations.

beats.character_action: Deniz stops treating the discrepancy as an emergency or a fluke and reframes it as a bounded pattern that is real enough to record but not proven for an advisory.
beats.external_event: The reviewer agrees over relay that the series is record-worthy but not advisory-grade.
beats.new_information: The series changes with tide state within this session, which excludes a fixed one-off error. It leaves cause and recurrence untested.
beats.escalation_delta: The choice becomes strengthen-or-record rather than alarm-or-dismiss.
beats.state_change: Deniz holds a bounded finding with a clear ceiling.
beats.payoff_contribution: Sets the claim the record may contain.

beats.purpose: Force the trade-off with about 40 minutes left.
beats.character_action: Deniz weighs a fresh independent setup against locking the current evidence as a provisional record.
beats.external_event: The remaining window fits either a full fresh-setup repeat or the documentation and review, not both.
beats.new_information: A fresh setup could strengthen or weaken the anomaly. The record would cover only the original setup.
beats.state_change: Deniz must commit the remaining window.

beats.purpose: Dramatize the chosen branch under time pressure.
beats.character_action: Deniz executes the chosen branch using the series, the logged confounds, and the reviewer's threshold.
beats.external_event: The final reading or presentation is produced exactly as the branch defines, and the reviewer responds as defined.
beats.new_information: The branch result resolves the local uncertainty.
beats.state_change: The record outcome is fixed for this branch.

beats.purpose: Land the local outcome and forward question.
beats.character_action: Deniz files the report at the harbor and answers the reviewer's questions.
beats.external_event: The freight movement proceeds or holds according to the report's actual recommendation, which is no route closure.
beats.new_information: Deniz knows what is on record, what is not, and what would upgrade it.
beats.state_change: Reviewer trust updates according to the branch.

escalation_ladder: The instrument check passes, so simple instrument error weakens as an explanation.
The tide series makes the anomaly structured, not a single point.
The harbor master and reviewer start acting on Deniz's wording.
The last two readings break the simple tide-proportional model.
The shrinking window forces an either/or choice.

reversal.prior_belief: Either the discrepancy is a setup or instrument fluke to be dismissed, or it is a clear tide-driven drift that may demand an advisory.

evidence.claim: The instrument passed its reference check and the setup was re-leveled.
The first reading was beyond official tolerance in the original setup.
Five unchanged-setup readings over about ninety minutes showed the offset shrinking as the tide fell, with slight temperature drift.
The last two readings depart from a simple tide-proportional trend.
Within this session the offset varies with time and tide state, so it is not a fixed one-off error.

reversal.reinterpretation: The anomaly is a real, session-bounded, time-varying discrepancy that is record-worthy, but it does not support an advisory.
reversal.inference_ceiling: The evidence does not establish recurrence, physical cause, the beacon as the source, setup-independence, or scope beyond this beacon. Tide and time remain confounded with temperature.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: It is unknown whether the cause is the beacon, the setup, temperature, or a wider chart disagreement, and whether an independent setup would reproduce the pattern.

decision_point.pressure: Roughly 40 minutes remain: either a fresh independent setup or a reviewed provisional record can be completed, not both.

branches.option: Spend the window on a fresh independent setup.
branches.immediate_action: Deniz breaks down, re-sites and re-levels with a different reference, and takes a new reading pair at the falling tide.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: One independent repeat pair reproduces an offset of the same direction and similar size, but the unreviewed series is not formally documented.
branches.cost_or_risk: The window closes before full documentation and review, so no reviewed log is completed and the freight goes ahead without a formal record.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: The reviewer respects the rigor but is uneasy about the missing paperwork, and Deniz must file a follow-up request for a reviewed log.
branches.climax_requirement: Dramatize the reset under time pressure and the repeat pair matching the direction; the reviewer says it is stronger, not advisory-grade, and cannot be logged tonight.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: Stronger evidence, with an offset that survives one independent reset, but no reviewed log and no advisory; the milestone is not eligible until the log is reviewed.

branches.option: Preserve the bounded evidence as a reviewed provisional record and decline to recommend closure.
branches.immediate_action: Deniz documents the series with its confounds and ceilings, and submits it for reviewer sign-off before dusk.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: The five-reading series stands as documented, with no fresh-setup test and the setup-dependence caveat explicit.
branches.cost_or_risk: The setup-independence question stays open, and a later independent test could weaken the record.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: The reviewer trusts Deniz's calibrated judgment and grants a reviewed provisional log, with a scheduled independent follow-up.
branches.climax_requirement: Dramatize drafting exact wording under time pressure, refusing to escalate to closure, and the reviewer signing the provisional entry.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: A dated, reviewed provisional discrepancy record with no advisory, making first_discrepancy_logged eligible.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Whether the discrepancy holds under an independent setup, and whether it recurs.

architect_raw_payload.climax: Deniz commits the final forty minutes to one branch and produces that branch's fixed result under dusk pressure, using the tide series, the confound log, and the reviewer's thresholds, with no new facts.
architect_raw_payload.local_payoff: Deniz establishes what is professionally on record: a bounded, tide-varying anomaly, with no route closure, cause, or recurrence claimed.
architect_raw_payload.forward_hook: Whether this is an isolated local drift or the first visible edge of a wider chart-system disagreement now depends on an independent follow-up.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: A dated, bounded field record of a tide-varying discrepancy at Beacon Ridge.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: The delivered prose shows the series and its confounds documented.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: The reviewer updates trust in Deniz's judgment under uncertainty.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: The reviewer explicitly responds to Deniz's threshold reasoning.
The follow-up is explicitly requested or agreed on-page.
A reviewed provisional log is completed, which happens only under the provisional_record branch.

completion_evidence: A documented out-of-tolerance reading with tide, time, and temperature
A structured series showing variation, with confounds stated
A working hypothesis that the anomaly is not simple mistake, without a cause claim
A reviewed log completed, which occurs only under the provisional_record branch

anti_repetition_signature.main_location_pattern: Harbor briefing, ridge fieldwork, harbor close
anti_repetition_signature.climax_shape: Committing the last window to one evidence strategy
anti_repetition_signature.distinct_from_recent_episodes_because: No prior episodes exist; the tension is professional restraint rather than a physical obstacle.

writer_rules: Do not add a route advisory or closure
Do not claim cause, recurrence, or scope beyond this beacon
Do not choose the branch before the decision beat
Give each branch exactly its defined result and reviewer response
The mark establishes only a historical offset
One fresh-setup repeat does not prove setup-independence
No new evidence in the climax
Keep resolution of the father's fate out of the episode
